scope.purpose: Support Astra's minimum-recoverability validation design with task identity, historical exposure, cost, and comparison-boundary evidence.

identity_and_exposure.canonical_rule: normalized relative POSIX task_directory/trial_directory; prefix aliases do not create new episodes. A task-level exclusion conservatively covers all trials below that task.
identity_and_exposure.future_inheritance: The append-only observed-use record states all seeds/prefixes/aliases of each of the 96 canonical task/trial identities inherit ever-used TRAIN status.

supported_candidate_metadata_differences.interpretation: Known-use differences only. The 74 valid_unseen identities are not used here and are not certified held-out or clean merely because they were absent from the registered union.

adopted_metadata_partition.claim_scope: The 600 are metadata-reserved TRAIN task/trial identities, exactly disjoint from the represented 2612 known-use union, the consumed 96, and the other P3 partitions. This does not prove no unregistered historical viewing or scene/template similarity, and is not a held-out generalization claim.

explicit_limitations.historical_viewing_absence: NOT_PROVEN; source/register inventory is not exhaustive proof that no other identities were inspected.
explicit_limitations.R4_and_R16_to_R18_global_prefix_cohort_m: PARTIALLY_UNRESOLVED: some manifests contain prefix/position counts without complete canonical task/trial joins.
explicit_limitations.seed_variant_prefix_aliases: Ever-used status is inherited by the recorded canonical identity rule; no claim that a different unseen scene is independent.
explicit_limitations.scene_layout_object_or_prompt_similarity: NOT_AUDITED; exact identity disjointness does not rule it out.
explicit_limitations.task_body_or_heldout_payloads: Not opened by the observed-use appendix or this audit.

all_17_failures.interpretation: Horizon-aligned terminal zero-reward source failures; not logged as truncations, parser rejections, or proven recoverable states.

seven_S5_unusable.direct_reason: S5_done_true: terminal success was already reached at the proposed five-action anchor, so no post-S5 intervention state exists.

upper_bound_gate.meaning: Structural source counts only; the preregistered F minimum was not met, so frozen learning/teacher protocol cannot proceed.

engineering_costs_separate_never_added_t.scope: SI-S01 bounded engineering public-path observation, not science
Separate engineering diagnostic; not SI-S01 science
engineering_costs_separate_never_added_t.model_load_unit: started then failed/open at CUDA UUID guard; actual model weights were not loaded

engineering_costs_separate_never_added_t.note: Resource diagnostic only; not an inference memory-fit or GPU-ownership proof.

same_state_comparison_boundary.historical_P0_reference_available: The completed source run records P0 actions/outcomes through the source horizon and existing read-only analysis records all 96 step-5 anchor references/state fields matching the corresponding rows.
same_state_comparison_boundary.no_new_CONTINUE_call: The archived P0 continuation can be a zero-new-call descriptive reference. Replaying its saved action suffix would test environment response to recorded commands, not produce a fresh CONTINUE policy decision.
same_state_comparison_boundary.fresh_CONTINUE_call: A prospectively frozen CONTINUE arm would require its own reset and five-action prefix replay plus up to 45 P0 generations/actions per branch; it increases physical costs below.
same_state_comparison_boundary.comparable_state_check: At minimum compare exact S5 observation text, full ordered action map, reward, done/truncated flags, canonical action IDs and row/event references before intervention. Mismatch must stop that case with no replacement.
same_state_comparison_boundary.causal_limit: Even exact public-state equality does not establish identical hidden simulator/RNG state. Without a fresh matched CONTINUE branch, historical success/failure contrast is descriptive and cannot estimate the counterfactual causal benefit of intervention.
same_state_comparison_boundary.same_identity_limit: The 17 failures and any reused success controls are already-used development TRAIN task identities, not fresh independent tasks or held-out evaluation cases.

required_before_any_future_execution: Astra/root-approved prospective protocol that freezes arm definitions, sample identities, comparator choice, and stop rules before outcomes.
Fresh explicit human scientific authorization, exact-source review, and single-use launch clearance; prior A96/engineering releases are consumed.
Current identity rejoin to all represented registers and explicit nonclaim for unresolved historical views and scene/template similarity.
Exact S5 public-state comparison and fail-closed replay contract; no replacement when a case fails its pre-action check.
Trusted worker-PID-to-GPU-UUID ownership evidence and fresh resource/runtime bounds before any weights load.
